desc: OpenCTI integration for IOC and observable enrichment. Supports observable lookups, indicator details retrieval, and entity search using the OpenCTI GraphQL API.

functions.label: Lookup Observable
functions.name: lookup_observable
functions.desc: Look up observables (IP, domain, URL, hash) in OpenCTI for enrichment data

inParameters.label: Observables
inParameters.name: observables
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list or array of observable values

inParameters.label: Observable Type
inParameters.name: observable_type
inParameters.desc: Type of observable (IPv4-Addr, Domain-Name, Url, StixFile)

functions.label: Get Indicator Details
functions.name: get_indicator_details
functions.desc: Get full indicator details including kill chain phases, labels, and confidence score

inParameters.label: Indicator IDs
inParameters.name: indicator_ids
inParameters.desc: Comma-separated list or array of OpenCTI indicator IDs

functions.label: Search Entities
functions.name: search_entities
functions.desc: Search across OpenCTI STIX domain objects by keyword and optional entity type

inParameters.label: Search Term
inParameters.name: search_term
inParameters.desc: Keyword to search for across OpenCTI entities

inParameters.label: Entity Type
inParameters.name: entity_type
inParameters.desc: Optional STIX domain object type filter (e.g., Malware, Threat-Actor, Campaign)

inParameters.label: Limit
inParameters.name: limit
inParameters.desc: Maximum number of results to return (default: 25)
